sources.details: For one unweighted class-index target with no smoothing, L=log(sum_c exp z_c)-z_y in nats; dL/dz_c=softmax(z)_c-1[c=y]. B=1,C=4, class axis1 and denominator1. Increasing false target z3 increases p3 and lowers label3 loss while lowering p2 and increasing label2 loss. Supervised-target sums count assistant bytes+EOS, so repetition/length can raise counted target share without determining final shared-model behavior.
